To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Knowledge is the new competitive weapon in business, and KM is the new management discipline that enables the creation, capture, sharing, transfer, and use of knowledge in organizations for the purposes of achieving organizational goals.
The concept of Knowledge Management (KM), is an important tool for organisational management.
KM has become an important tool for organisations to gain and sustain competitive advantage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the management of knowledge and its impact on the effectiveness of organisations.
the importance and relevance of KM to organisational effectiveness, the challenges of KM and the strategies for effective KM.
the role and importance of knowledge management in the organisation, and its impact on the organisational performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
KM is a process of creating, sharing, and using knowledge to enhance organisational performance.
KM is an important tool for organisations in the 21st century.
the management of an organisation's knowledge assets can provide the organisation with a sustainable competitive advantage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

knowledge management is a process of managing the creation, capture, dissemination and use of knowledge in organisations to enhance the effectiveness of the organisation in its pursuit of its strategic objectives.
knowledge management is a discipline that promotes an integrated approach to identifying, capturing, evaluating, retrieving, sharing and enhancing the knowledge and information of an enterprise.
the management of organisational knowledge has become a strategic imperative for all types of organisations.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the management of intellectual capital is a key to success in the knowledge economy (Choo and Bontis, 2002; Desouza, 2011) Knowledge management is the process of systematically and efficiently changing organisational members' knowledge, attitudes, and behaviours to help them to achieve their objectives and goals.
KM can be an effective tool for organisational performance.
the management of human capital, which is the key to the management of knowledge in an organisation, is a key to success and competitive advantage in the knowledge based economy.
